findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_gpu_prices · Private data: estimate_finetune_cost · Public sink: list_gpu_prices, estimate_finetune_cost · Destructive: match_workload, estimate_finetune_cost.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_gpu_prices · Private data: estimate_finetune_cost · Public sink: list_gpu_prices, estimate_finetune_cost · Destructive: match_workload, estimate_finetune_cost

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
